H5400.def: a primitive root; to catch fire:--burn, kindle.

H5401.et: a primitive root [identical with (05400), through the idea of fastening up
H5401.def: a primitive root (identical with «05400», through the idea of fastening up; compare «02388», «02836»); to kiss, literally or figuratively (touch); also (as a mode of attachment), to equip with weapons:--armed (men), rule, kiss, that touched.

H5402.def: or nesheq {nay'-shek}; from «05401»; military equipment, i.e. (collectively) arms (offensive or defensive), or (concretely) an arsenal:--armed men, armour(-y), battle, harness, weapon.

H5404.et: from an unused root meaning to lacerate
H5404.def: from an unused root meaning to lacerate; the eagle (or other large bird of prey):--eagle.

H5405.def: a primitive root; properly, to eliminate, i.e. (intransitively) to dry up:--fail.

H5406.def: probably of Persian origin; an epistle:--letter.

H5408.def: a primitive root; to dismember:--cut (in pieces), divide, hew in pieces.

H5410.et: from an unused root meaning to tramp
H5410.def: or (feminine) nthiybah {neth-ee-baw'}; or nthibah (Jeremiah 6:16) {neth-ee-baw'}; from an unused root meaning to tramp; a (beaten) track:--path((-way)), × travel(-ler), way.

H5411.def: or Nathuwn (Ezra 8:17) {naw-thoon'} (the proper form as passive participle), from «05414»; one given, i.e. (in the plural only) the Nethinim, or Temple-servants (as given to that duty):--Nethinims.

H5413.def: a primitive root; to flow forth (literally or figuratively); by implication, to liquify:--drop, gather (together), melt, pour (forth, out).

H5414.def: a primitive root; to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.):--add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, × avenge, × be ((healed)), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count, + cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, × doubtless, × without fail, fasten, frame, × get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), × have, × indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), + lie, lift up, make, + O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, × pull , put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up), + sing, + slander, strike, (sub-)mit, suffer, × surely

H5416.def: from «05414»; given; Nathan, the name of five Israelites:--Nathan.

H5417.def: from «05414» and «0410»; given of God; Nethanel, the name of ten Israelites:--Nethaneel.

H5418.def: or Nthanyahuw {neth-an-yaw'-hoo}; from «05414» and «03050»; given of Jah; Nethanjah, the name of four Israelites:--Nethaniah.

H5419.def: from «05414» and «04428»; given of (the) king; Nethan-Melek, an Israelite:--Nathan-melech.

H5420.def: a primitive root; to tear up:--mar.

H5422.def: a primitive root; to tear down:--beat down, break down (out), cast down, destroy, overthrow, pull down, throw down.

H5423.def: a primitive root; to tear off:--break (off), burst, draw (away), lift up, pluck (away, off), pull (out), root out.

H5425.def: a primitive root; to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie:--drive asunder, leap, (let) loose, × make, move, undo.

H5427.def: from «05425»; mineral potash (so called from effervescing with acid):--nitre.

H5428.def: a primitive root; to tear away:--destroy, forsake, pluck (out, up, by the roots), pull up, root out (up), × utterly.

H5429.et: from an unused root meaning to define
H5429.def: from an unused root meaning to define; a seah, or certain measure (as determinative) for grain:--measure.

H5430.def: from «05431»; perhaps a military boot (as a protection from mud:--battle.

H5431.def: a primitive root; to be miry; used only as denominative from «05430»; to shoe, i.e. (active participle) a soldier shod:--warrior.

H5433.def: a primitive root; to quaff to satiety, i.e. become tipsy:--drunkard, fill self, Sabean, (wine-)bibber.

H5434.def: of foreign origin; Seba, a son of Cush, and the country settled by him:--Seba.

H5435.def: from «05433»; potation, concretely (wine), or abstractly (carousal):--drink, drunken, wine.

H5436.def: patrial from «05434»; a Sebaite, or inhabitant of Seba:--Sabean.

H5437.def: a primitive root; to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively (as follows):--bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, × whirl, × round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, × circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, × on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

H5439.def: or (feminine) cbiybah {seb-ee-baw'}; from «05437»; (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around:--(place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

H5440.def: a primitive root; to entwine:--fold together, wrap.

H5443.def: (Aramaic) or sabbka: (Aramaic) {sab-bek- aw'}; from a root corresponding to «05440»; a lyre:--sackbut.

H5444.def: from «05440»; copse-like; Sibbecai, an Israelite:--Sibbecai, Sibbechai.

H5445.def: a primitive root; to carry (literally or figuratively), or (reflexively) be burdensome; specifically, to be gravid:--bear, be a burden, carry, strong to labour.

H5447.def: from «05445»; a load (literally or figuratively):--burden, charge.

H5448.def: (only in the form cubbal {soob-bawl'}; from «05445»; a load (figuratively):--burden.

H5449.def: from «05445»; a porter:--(to bear, bearer of) burden(-s).

H5452.def: (Aramaic) a primitive root; to bear in mind, i.e. hope:--think.

H5453.et: dual from a root corresponding to (05452)
H5453.def: dual from a root corresponding to «05452»; double hope; Sibrajim, a place in Syria:--Sibraim.

H5454.def: or Cabtah {sab-taw'}; probably of foreign derivation; Sabta or Sabtah, the name of a son of Cush, and the country occupied by his posterity:--Sabta, Sabtah.

H5455.def: probably of foreign derivation; Sabteca, the name of a son of Cush, and the region settled by him:--Sabtecha, Sabtechah.

H5456.def: a primitive root; to prostrate oneself (in homage):--fall down.

H5458.def: from «05462»; properly, shut up, i.e. the breast (as inclosing the heart); also gold (as generally shut up safely):--caul, gold.

H5459.et: from an unused root meaning to shut up
H5459.def: feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to shut up; wealth (as closely shut up):--jewel, peculiar (treasure), proper good, special.

H5461.et: from an unused root meaning to superintend
H5461.def: from an unused root meaning to superintend; a prefect of a province:--prince, ruler.

H5462.def: a primitive root; to shut up; figuratively, to surrender:--close up, deliver (up), give over (up), inclose, × pure, repair, shut (in, self, out, up, up together), stop, × straitly.

H5464.et: probably from (05462) in the sense of sweeping away
H5464.def: probably from «05462» in the sense of sweeping away; a pouring rain:--very rainy.

H5465.et: from an unused root meaning to estop
H5465.def: from an unused root meaning to estop; the stocks:--stocks.

H5466.et: from an unused root meaning to envelop
H5466.def: from an unused root meaning to envelop; a wrapper, i.e. shirt:--fine linen, sheet.

H5467.et: from an unused root meaning to scorch
H5467.def: from an unused root meaning to scorch; burnt (i.e. volcanic or bituminous) district; Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea:-- Sodom.

H5468.et: from an unused root meaning to arrange
H5468.def: from an unused root meaning to arrange; order:--order.

H5469.et: from an unused root meaning to be round
H5469.def: from an unused root meaning to be round; roundness:--round.

H5470.def: from the same as «05469»; a dungeon (as surrounded by walls):--prison.

H5471.def: of foreign derivation; So, an Egyptian king:--So.

H5472.def: a primitive root; properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize):--backslider, drive, go back, turn (away, back).

H5473.et: a primitive root [probably rather identical with (05472) through the idea of shrinking from a hedge; compare (07735)]
H5473.def: a primitive root (probably rather identical with «05472» through the idea of shrinking from a hedge; compare «07735»); to hem in, i.e. bind:--set about.

H5474.def: from «05462»; an inclosure, i.e. cage (for an animal):--ward.

H5475.def: from «03245»; a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret:--assembly, consel, inward, secret (counsel).

H5476.def: from «05475»; a confidant; Sodi, an Israelite:--Sodi.

H5477.et: from an unused root meaning to wipe away
H5477.def: from an unused root meaning to wipe away; sweeping; Suach, an Israelite:--Suah.

H5478.def: from the same as «05477»; something swept away, i.e. filth:--torn.

H5479.def: from «07750»; roving; Sotai, one of the Nethinim:--Sotai.

H5480.def: a primitive root; properly, to smear over (with oil), i.e. anoint:--anoint (self), × at all.

H5481.def: (Aramaic) or cuwmponyah (Aramaic) {soom-po-neh-yaw'}; or ciyphonya: (Dan. 3:10) (Aramaic) {see-fo-neh-yaw'}; of Greek origin; a bagpipe (with a double pipe):--dulcimer.

H5482.def: (rather to be written Cvenah {sev-ay'-naw}; for Cven {sev-ane'}; i.e to Seven); of Egyptian derivation; Seven, a place in Upper Egypt:--Syene.

H5483.et: from an unused root meaning to skip (properly, for joy)
H5483.def: or cuc {soos}; from an unused root meaning to skip (properly, for joy); a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight):--crane, horse((-back, -hoof)). Compare «06571».

H5484.def: feminine of «05483»; a mare:--company of horses.

H5486.def: a primitive root; to snatch away, i.e. terminate:--consume, have an end, perish, × be utterly.

H5487.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05486»; to come to an end:-- consume, fulfill.

H5488.def: probably of Egyptian origin; a reed, especially the papyrus:--flag, Red (sea), weed. Compare «05489».

H5489.def: for «05488» (by ellipsis of «03220»); the Reed (Sea):--Red Sea.

H5490.def: from «05486»; a termination:--conclusion, end, hinder participle

H5492.def: from «05486»; a hurricane:--Red Sea, storm, tempest, whirlwind, Red sea.

H5493.def: or suwr (Hosea 9:12) {soor}; a primitive root; to turn off (literal or figurative):--be(-head), bring, call back, decline, depart, eschew, get (you), go (aside), × grievous, lay away (by), leave undone, be past, pluck away, put (away, down), rebel, remove (to and fro), revolt, × be sour, take (away, off), turn (aside, away, in), withdraw, be without.

H5494.def: probably passive participle of «05493»; turned off, i.e. deteriorated:--degenerate.

H5495.def: the same as «05494»; Sur, a gate of the temple:--Sur.

H5496.def: perhaps denominative from «07898»; properly, to prick, i.e. (figuratively) stimulate; by implication, to seduce:--entice, move, persuade, provoke, remove, set on, stir up, take away.

H5497.et: probably from the same root as (04533)
H5497.def: probably from the same root as «04533»; covering, i.e. clothing:--clothes.

H5498.def: a primitive root; to trail along:--draw (out), tear.
